headline: Front Ledger Turns Again Across Five Sectors
war_summary: The latest returns mark a sharp reshuffling since the previous edition. Nevish Line is now the most immediate flashpoint, with nine base events in the latest two hours and 52 over 24 hours; its ledger stands at one Warden, five Colonial, and two neutral positions, differing from the earlier two-Warden, six-Colonial count. Weathered Expanse has quieted in the latest watch after 16 events across six hours, but still logged 48 in the day and now shows seven Warden, no Colonial, and two neutral bases. Linn Mercy remains heavily engaged, recording two fresh events and 36 daily, with eight Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral holdings. Mooring County registered 16 daily changes but none in two hours, while Callahans Passage recorded five in six hours and 14 in the day despite its present all-Warden ledger. Marban Hollow is quieter, with 11 daily events and none in the latest two hours. Casualty and enlistment rates are rising in several of these sectors, yet the immediate evidence points to activity concentrated in Nevish Line and the unsettled central fronts.
